title: A Text-Book of Astronomy
author: George C. Comstock
published: D. Appleton and Company, New York, 1903 (copyright 1901)
subject: Astronomy and scientific education
about: A college textbook built on measurement, observation and celestial mechanics. QueryBook answers from the book alone, quoting it with chapter, section and paragraph, and sets every checked assertion beside what is established today.
